svg.title: Annual total ecosystem respiration (TER, = Reco) against annual gross primary production (GPP), one marker per site-year, with the SMEAR II Hyytiälä forest (rare management) as a reference; below the 1:1 line the site-year was a net CO2 sink. The Hyytiälä stand was thinned at the start of 2020 (de Quesada et al. 2025).
svg.desc: The scatter plot of Figure 1 (15 site-years of the six sites) with 6 site-years of the SMEAR II Hyytiälä Scots pine forest (green stars, a reference with rare management): x axis annual GPP (g C m−2 yr−1), y axis annual total ecosystem respiration (TER, = Reco; g C m−2 yr−1), both from 600 to 1600 on the same scale, dotted 1:1 line, faint grid lines every 200. Labels: Hyytiälä 2019 (pre-thinning), 2020 (thinning: the stand was thinned at the start of 2020, 40 % of the basal area removed, de Quesada et al. 2025) and the cluster 2021–2024. Hyytiälä (g C m−2 yr−1) 2019: GPP 1190, TER 977, NEE −214; 2020: GPP 968, TER 1083, NEE 115; 2021: GPP 1115, TER 971, NEE −144; 2022: GPP 1206, TER 1019, NEE −187; 2023: GPP 1208, TER 985, NEE −223; 2024: GPP 1249, TER 1001, NEE −248. Hyytiälä NEE −150 ± 134 (mean ± SD, range −248 to 115, n = 6); grassland −41 ± 138 (range −283 to 131, n = 10); annual crops −139 ± 183 (range −392 to 20, n = 5). 14 of 21 site-years are below the line. OLS line over all 21 site-years: TER = 0.59 × GPP + 337, r = 0.71.
